sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that earlier the prayer for bail of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 31.08.2022 passed in B.A No.8319 of 2022.

By way of present bail application, the applicant has renewed his prayer for bail, primarily for the reasons that after rejection of the first bail application, during the trial out of five charge-sheeted witnesses, three witnesses have been examined and their deposition are appended with the present bail application.
It is further submitted that the victim has also not supported the prosecution case.

It is further submitted that the applicant has been languishing in jail since 25.05.2022 and at least considering the length of judicial custody, the applicant may be given to privilege of regular bail.
4. Learned A.P.P appearing on behalf of the State vehemently opposed the contentions made by the learned counsel for the applicant.

entities.text: Akhilesh Yadav @ Akhlesh Yadav vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The first bail application of the applicant was earlier rejected by this Court vide order dated 31.08.2022 passed in B.A No.8319 of 2022 on merit.

After rejection of the first bail application, trial has commenced and the witnesses who have been examined before the learned Trial Court, have not supported the prosecution case their testimony cannot be evaluated at the time of disposal of the 2nd bail application.
6. In view of the submission made and materials on record, the plea raised by the learned counsel for the applicant cannot be accepted as a new ground for second bail application.
Accordingly, the second bail application of the applicant is hereby rejected.

(Subhash Chand, J.) Raja/-
